_comment: Ontario corporate rates. Every value unverified.

t2_general_rate.source: Ontario general corporate income tax rate, 11.5%. Ontario Budget 2026, Annex; confirmed against CRA, Ontario basic income tax. Checked 2026-09-15.

t2_small_business_rate.source: Ontario lower corporate income tax rate, 3.2%, for a taxation year ending before 1 July 2026. CRA, Ontario small business deduction: the deduction rate of 8.3% produces a lower tax rate of 3.2%. Checked 2026-09-15. The rate falls to 2.2% on 1 July 2026, which does not reach a 2025 tax year.
